text:
mia_cs: Heads-up: TidalHealth wants to move their upcoming 12mo renewal to 9mo to align with their fiscal Q. Theyre asking for a one-time credit and need the invoice to hit after signature. PO link they provided: https://procure.tidalhealth/PO-9077
raj_ae: Do they want a different billing entity or currency switch?
elin_fin: Need the numbers. ARR is $48k. 9mo pro-rata = $36k. They requested a 12% one-time credit which would be $31,680. Our delegated approval cap is 10%. If it's 12% we need finance+rev ops signoff. Also need vendor_code and payment terms (Net30/Net60).
mia_cs: They said "Net30 ACH" and the PO includes vendor code VC-2211, but the PO references an internal contract ID; might need legal to confirm no conflicts.
tess_legal: If the PO references additional terms, we need to review. Otherwise we can do our standard amendment template and send via AdobeSign. Please paste the PO text or attach.
esign_bot: AdobeSign envelope prepared AS-2099-17. Waiting on "finance_approved" flag and vendor_code attachment.
raj_ae: I'll upload the PO PDF here and flag the account owner to confirm the 12% ask. If they want to lock seats, mention that impacts prorate.
elin_fin: For 12% the revenue impact is small but outside delegation. I'll provisionally approve up to 10%. Please escalate if customer insists on 12%.
tess_legal: Upload PO. If it references another master agreement, include the contract ID so I can cross-check. If nothing unusual, I'll draft a short amendment by EOD.
mia_cs: Uploaded PO snippet: "PO-9077 | vendor VC-2211 | references MSA ID: MSA-2021-44". Tagging legal.
raj_ae: Spoke to procurement; they said 12% is a courtesy ask but open to 10% to keep things moving. Procurement will sign if we accept 10% and Net30 ACH.
elin_fin: OK, marking finance_approved for 10% credit. We'll document the one-time credit as line-item credit on the invoice. No Net60.
tess_legal: Draft ready: short amendment referencing MSA-2021-44, term shortened to 9 months, one-time credit line. Uploaded: https://drive.redwood/amendments/tidal-9mo-draft. No extra clauses.
esign_bot: Envelope AS-2099-17 updated with amendment and PO. Sent to customer. Envelope ID env_b7c3.
mia_cs: Actions: (1) final AE confirmation on 10% (raj) (2) finance confirmed 10% (elin) (3) legal uploaded amendment (tess) (4) I send AdobeSign (done). Will update when signed. :thumbsup:
raj_ae: Confirmed 10% with customer. Theyre approving the amendment tonight.
mia_cs: Great, closing loop when signed and will route invoice to accounting. :party_popper:
